annotations.title: List C and embedded interview practice problems

description: Lists breadboardhub's C and embedded interview practice problems: firmware and robotics questions such as a timer rollover bug, register bit fields, a switch debouncer, a ring buffer, a quadrature encoder decoder, fixed-point filters, CAN frame packing and a PID step. Use this when the person asks "help me practise for an embedded C interview" or "give me a firmware interview question". Each is graded by hidden tests on an emulated ATmega328P. Returns each problem's id, title, difficulty, topics, suggested minutes and page link. Free, with no daily limit.
